world.laws: Local councils set their own rules. In Goldmere, necromancy is regulated; in Mossbell, it is permitted; in Fernbridge, it is forbidden. Authorities act on witnesses, reports, and discovered evidence. Willing ancestral contact, grave theft, and unwilling soul binding are treated as different acts.
world.culture: Wild groves are protected as common ground, and moon watchers teach respect for changing seasons.

festival.name: The Returning Lanterns
festival.tradition: Families share a public meal and leave a place for absent friends.

rumors: The academy in Goldmere is seeking careful field observers, not only wealthy students.
A moonwise ranger near The Wrenwood can teach a refuge ritual without demanding allegiance.
Licensed ancestral research is attracting healers from distant villages.

mentors.name: Ser Elian Vale
mentors.description: A sworn protector offers training and an initiation founded on a visible oath of mercy and protection.

mentors.name: Scholar Tamsin
mentors.description: A physician teaches consensual ancestral rites and sponsors students studying the ruined archive.

mentors.name: Vey the Quiet
mentors.description: A discreet contact offers a test of stealth and judgment, with the terms disclosed before accepting.

changes.title: The Winter Levy
changes.text: You accept forty gold and keep the second levy intact. Adri es Salveto opens a controlled trading desk to your allies. Imzavelle sa Ishumara records your refusal to help and will not mistake payment for vindication.

snapshot.title: The price of keeping quiet
snapshot.body: Forty gold bought your silence about the second levy. The controlled trading desk is still the service we agreed. That is a bargain, not a new name for friendship.

choices.label: Ask a particular question
choices.description: Choose these words. No days, payment, relationship or skill reward.
choices.text: Do you think that bargain settles everything between us?
choices.response: It settles what was paid and what was kept quiet. It gives neither of us the right to invent the other’s loyalties.

choices.label: Offer your own view
choices.description: Choose these words. No days, payment, relationship or skill reward.
choices.text: I can accept that bargain and still dislike it.
choices.response: You can. Discomfort does not change the entry in the account, but you need not perform delight for me.

choices.label: Change the subject
choices.description: Choose these words. No days, payment, relationship or skill reward.
choices.text: I would rather speak about something else today.
choices.response: Then let us leave the levy there. You need not discuss it each time we meet.

choices.label: End the conversation
choices.description: Choose these words. No days, payment, relationship or skill reward.
choices.text: I am going to leave this conversation here.
choices.response: All right. There is no further answer owed today.
